author: gyalchester
body:
I just wanted to ask if any PvP mods are allowed? Personally i use 5Zigs (but not on Avicus) and it is allowed on many servers such as Cosmic Pvp etc. So just wanted to clarify! 

Thanks!

title: PvP Mods?

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
1. The mods listed below are permitted for use through Avicus:
    1. Optifine
    2. Gammabright
    3. Mods that change Minecraft's graphical user interface
    4. Toggle Sprint
    5. Rei.s minimap
    6. 5zig PvP Modification
We do allow some other mods that aren't listed on that page, such as Laby mod (If you count that as a PVP mod). Apart from that we don't allow much else. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Administrator
